device.name: Kinova Gen3 Reach in Isaac Lab (Gen3-Reach-v0)

facts.text: The repository is a standalone Isaac Lab extension for training reinforcement-learning agents on the Kinova Gen3 and deploying them in Isaac Sim or on the real robot via ROS2
Isaac Lab is installed first, and the Python package is installed with python -m pip install -e source/gen3
The Sim2Real pipeline runs with ROS2 and does not require Isaac Lab or Isaac Sim to be installed

The task package imports gymnasium and registers Gen3-Reach-v0 with gym.register; its entry point is isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv, its environment configuration is joint_pos_env_cfg:Gen3ReachEnvCfg and the environment checker is disabled
Gen3ReachEnvCfg subclasses ReachEnvCfg and sets the scene robot to KINOVA_GEN3_N7_CFG at the prim path {ENV_REGEX_NS}/Robot
The reset event reset_robot_joints uses the position range (0.75, 1.25)
The action is a JointPositionActionCfg over joint_names ['.*'] with scale 0.5 and use_default_offset=True
The end-effector command targets the body end_effector_link and fixes the pitch range at pi/2
The simulation timestep is 0.016666666666666666 s
The decimation is 2, so one policy step advances two simulation timesteps
The scene robot's initial joint positions are joint_1 0.0, joint_2 0.65, joint_3 0.0, joint_4 1.89, joint_5 0.0, joint_6 0.6 and joint_7 -1.57
The sim2real mapping treats a simulation joint angle as radians and converts it to degrees with np.rad2deg
The scene robot is the Kinova Gen3 N7, loaded from gen3n7_instanceable.usd
The arm actuators have effort limits of 39.0 for joint_1 to joint_4 and 9.0 for joint_5 to joint_7 and a velocity limit of 100.0
The reset event reset_joints_by_scale scales the default joint positions by a factor from 0.75 to 1.25 and sets the joint velocities from the range 0.0 to 0.0
The policy observation group concatenates the joint_pos_rel, joint_vel_rel, ee_pose command and last_action terms, with corruption enabled
The joint position and joint velocity observations add uniform noise from -0.01 to 0.01

The ee_pose command is a UniformPoseCommand for end_effector_link resampled every 4.0 s, with position ranges x 0.35 to 0.65, y -0.2 to 0.2 and z 0.15 to 0.5, roll 0.0, pitch 1.5707963267948966 and yaw -3.14 to 3.14
An episode lasts 12.0 s
The only termination is the time-out term
The joint-position action term is not clipped (clip: null)
The recorded environment configuration seeds the run with 42
The training configuration leaves clip_actions null
The extension declares isaaclab, isaaclab_assets, isaaclab_mimic, isaaclab_rl and isaaclab_tasks as dependencies
The package requires Python 3.10 or newer

determinism.notes: the fake reseeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed), so one seed repeats the fake's own trajectory; Isaac Lab draws the joint scales, the pose command and the observation noise from numpy/torch generators, so the same seed is not claimed to reproduce an Isaac Sim trajectory

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in (F0): no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator effort or velocity limits (env.yaml:157-165), sensor or rendering model; the joint positions are set directly to the scaled action and were never compared with an Isaac Sim run

the action space is published as an unbounded seven-value Box because the clone records the joint-position action, its scale 0.5 and clip: null but no numeric action bound (env.yaml:339-350); the real Isaac Lab Box bounds were not observed

the policy observation group is modelled with four seven-value terms (joint_pos, joint_vel, pose_command, actions); the clone's joint_pos_rel and joint_vel_rel are computed by Isaac Lab term functions and the command width is the pose command's position plus quaternion, so torch-level dtype, layout and corruption details were not observed

the reward is a constant 0.0 placeholder, not the configured sum of end-effector tracking, action-rate and joint-velocity terms (env.yaml:370-488), because the forward kinematics and command error are external Isaac Lab functions
only the 12.0 s time-out truncates an episode (env.yaml:369, :490-494); the tracking reward terms and PhysX contacts are not modelled

the reset event scales the default joint positions by a factor in (0.75, 1.25) (env.yaml:352-360) and the command is resampled every 4.0 s (env.yaml:508-513), but the fake draws both from Python's random.Random, not numpy/torch, so a seed does not reproduce an Isaac Sim episode
the sim backend (gymnasium.make('Gen3-Reach-v0')) was not run: it needs Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, PhysX, torch and a GPU (env.yaml:20 and :78; README.md:25)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and one tick advances simulated time by 33.33 ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair in the clone

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
